poc_summary: POC scope: validate Dedicated capacity plan to meet sustained throughput and latency SLOs for real-time agent workloads. Deliverables: (1) Load and soak test report (throughput, p95/p99 latency, token cost), (2) Capacity recommendation (GPU count, instance mix) for production reservation, (3) Draft SLA with uptime and credits, (4) Runbook for failover to secondary model variants.
performance_targets: Sustained throughput: target 250-300 req/s for 1k concurrent sessions (typical chat turn = 512 tokens)
Latency SLOs: p95 < 150ms for generation-only tail tokens; p99 < 400ms acceptable for full-turn under steady state
Burst handling: maintain >= 150 req/s within 60s for 30% additional load (burst pool)
reserved_gpu_planning: Initial recommendation: 4 x A100-40GB equiv for model variant A (fp16), + 2 x T4-equivalent for embeddings and rerankers
Autoscale policy: scale up additional 2 GPUs for sustained > 85% utilization for 10 minutes
KV cache sizing: allocate 200GB per serving node to cover 95th percentile sequence lengths
Expected token cost estimate: $0.018 per 1k tokens served (pre-negotiation)
test_plan: Load tests: step-wise ramp to 350 req/s over 90 minutes with representative prompt mixes
Soak tests: 72-hour sustained run at 70% of target throughput to measure degradation, memory leaks, cache churn
Failure injection: simulate node loss and cold-starts to measure recovery and latency spikes
Representative prompts: mix of short conversational, 512-token code-completion, and 1k-token summarization (for tail cases)
representative_prompts: Customer support agent: 'Context: last 6 messages... Provide empathetic summary and next-action in 2 bullets.' (~120 tokens)
Code assist: 'Refactor the following function to be async and add error handling...' (~400 tokens prompt + 300 tokens completion)
Reranking: 'Rank these 10 search results by relevance to query X; attach score 0-1.' (embedding + reranker path)
Batch summarization: 'Summarize quarterly simulation logs into 800–1000 token brief.' (tail/long-seq test)
measurement_plan: Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (generation + total turn), throughput (req/s), GPU util, KV cache hit rate, token cost per 1M tokens
Data collection: export traces to Console (per-route), enable token-level cost breakdown, capture system-level metrics for each serving node
Acceptance criteria: p95 latency below target for >= 95% of intervals during soak; no memory growth > 5% over 72h; failover recovery < 30s
Report: include raw logs, CSV of latency histograms, cost delta by batching and quantization profiles
sla_negotiation_points: Guaranteed reserved throughput with rollback/credits if underprovisioned
Scheduled maintenance windows outside 08:00-20:00 PST; max 1 hour/month impacting capacity
Incident response: 1-hour sev1 response SLA for Dedicated customers; 4-hour mitigation target
Capacity elasticity: documented burst pool and priority routing for critical routes
Model fallbacks: automatic downgraded variant path and documented quality regression thresholds
